external_inputs: Complete full-grid annual-output archive; selected archived example files are included
file_scope: Current manuscript, maintained model and analysis dependencies, frozen configurations, tests and numerical evidence. Superseded drafts, duplicated source snapshots and unused outputs are excluded.
